# entr - Event Notify Test Runner

A utility for running arbitrary commands when files change. `entr` watches files and executes commands when they are modified.

## Description

`entr` reads a list of files from standard input and executes a specified command when any of those files change. It provides a fast, efficient way to get rapid feedback during development.

## Usage

```
entr [-acdnprsxz] utility [argument /_ ...]
```

## Options

- `-a` - Respond to all events which occur while the utility is running
- `-c` - Clear the screen before invoking the utility (specify twice to erase scrollback)
- `-d` - Track the parent directory of files. Specify twice to recognize all new directory entries
- `-n` - Run in non-interactive mode
- `-p` - Postpone the first execution until a file is modified
- `-r` - Reload a persistent child process
- `-s` - Evaluate the first argument using the SHELL environment variable
- `-x` - Format custom exit status messages using awk
- `-z` - Exit after the utility completes

## Special Features

- The argument `/_` is replaced with the absolute path of the first file to trigger an event
- Press `space` to manually execute the utility
- Press `q` to quit

## Environment Variables

- `ENTR_STATUS_SCRIPT` - Path to exit status script (default: `$HOME/.entr/status.awk`)
- `ENTR_RESTART_SIGNAL` - Signal used to terminate the utility (HUP, INT, QUIT, TERM, USR1, USR2)
- `ENTR_INOTIFY_WORKAROUND` - Enable for incomplete inotify support (WSL, Docker for Mac)
- `ENTR_FOLLOW_SYMLINK` - Follow symlinks (Mac OS and Linux)
- `EV_TRACE` - Print file system event messages
- `SHELL` - Specify shell for `-s` flag (default: `/bin/sh`)
- `PAGER` - Default set to `/bin/cat`

## Examples

Rebuild a project if source files change, limiting output to the first 20 lines:

```bash
$ find src/ | entr -s 'make | head -n 20'
```

Launch and auto-reload a node.js server:

```bash
$ ls *.js | entr -r node app.js
```

Clear the screen and run a query after the SQL script is updated:

```bash
$ echo my.sql | entr -cp psql -f /_
```

Rebuild project if a source file is modified or added to the src/ directory:

```bash
$ while sleep 0.1; do ls -d src src/*.rb | entr -d make; done
```

Auto-reload a web server, or terminate if the server exits:

```bash
$ ls * | entr -rz ./httpd
```

## Exit Status

When `-z` flag is set, returns the exit status of the child process.

Otherwise:
- `0` - Normal termination after receiving SIGINT
- `1` - No regular files provided or error occurred
- `2` - Files were added or removed from a directory

## Interactive Commands

While entr is running:
- `space` - Execute the utility immediately
- `q` - Quit

## Platform Support

Supported on BSD, Mac OS, and Linux systems. On Mac OS and Linux, symlinks are not followed unless `ENTR_FOLLOW_SYMLINK` is set.

For environments with incomplete inotify support (Windows Subsystem for Linux, Docker for Mac), set `ENTR_INOTIFY_WORKAROUND` to enable proper operation.

which terminates is not executed again until a file system or keyboard event is
processed.
A process group is created to prevent shell scripts from masking signals.
.Nm
waits for the
.Ar utility
to exit to ensure that resources such as sockets have been closed.
Control of the TTY is not transferred to the child process.
.It Fl s
Evaluate the first argument using the interpreter specified by the
.Ev SHELL
environment variable.
.It Fl x
Format custom exit status messages using a persistent
.Xr awk 1
process.
The path to the status script is defined by the environment variable
.Ev ENTR_STATUS_SCRIPT .
If the status script does not exist,
.Nm
will create an example.
Shell commands and file redirection is not permitted by default, but may be
enabled by specifying
.Fl x
twice.
.It Fl z
Exit after the
.Ar utility
completes.
When combined with
.Fl r
the
.Ar utility
will be restarted again only in response to commands or file system
events.
.El
.Pp
The first argument named
.Ar /_
is replaced with the absolute path of the first file to trigger an event.
The first file under watch is used as the default.
If the
.Fl s
option is used, the name of the first file to trigger an event can be read from
.Va $0 .
.Sh COMMANDS
.Nm
listens for keyboard input and responds to the following commands:
.Bl -tag -width <space>
.It Aq Cm space
Execute the utility immediately.
If the
.Fl Cm r
option is set this will terminate and restart the child process as if a file
change event had occurred.
.It Cm q
Quit; equivalent pressing
.Aq Cm control-C .
.El
.Sh ENVIRONMENT
.Bl -tag -width "ENTR_ENVIRON"
.It Ev ENTR_STATUS_SCRIPT
The path to the exit status script enabled by the
.Fl x
option.
By default
.Pa $HOME/.entr/status.awk
is evaluated.
.It Ev ENTR_RESTART_SIGNAL
Signal used to terminate the
.Ar utility .
Supported signal names are
.Dv HUP ,
.Dv INT ,
.Dv QUIT ,
.Dv TERM ,
.Dv USR1
and
.Dv USR2 .
The default is
.Dv SIGTERM .
.It Ev EV_TRACE
Print file system event messages.
.It Ev PAGER
Set to
.Pa /bin/cat
by default
to prevent interactive utilities from waiting for keyboard input if output does
not fit on the screen.
.It Ev SHELL
Specify the shell to use with the
.Fl s
flag.
The default is
.Pa /bin/sh .
.El
.Sh EXIT STATUS
If the
.Fl z
flag is set and the
.Ar utility
is successfully executed, the status of the child process is returned.
If the child process was terminated by a signal, the exit status is the signal
number plus 128.
.Pp
.Nm
normally returns one of the following values:
.Pp
.Bl -tag -width Ds -offset indent -compact
.It 0
Normal termination after receiving
.Dv SIGINT
.It 1
No regular files were provided as input or an error occurred
.It 2
Files were added or removed from a directory
.El
.Sh EXAMPLES
Rebuild a project if source files change, limiting output to the first 20 lines:
.Pp
.Dl $ find src/ | entr -s 'make | head -n 20'
.Pp
Launch and auto-reload a node.js server:
.Pp
.Dl $ ls *.js | entr -r node app.js
.Pp
Clear the screen and run a query after the SQL script is updated:
.Pp
.Dl $ echo my.sql | entr -cp psql -f /_
.Pp
Rebuild project if a source file is modified or added to the src/ directory:
.Pp
.Dl $ while sleep 0.1; do ls -d src src/*.rb | entr make; done
.Pp
Auto-reload a web server, or terminate if the server exits
.Pp
.Dl $ ls * | entr -rz ./httpd

import subprocess, os, time, signal, sys, select, fcntl

class Entr:
    def __init__(self, args, files, env=None, cwd=None):
        e=dict(os.environ)
        if env:
            for k,v in env.items():
                if v is None: e.pop(k,None)
                else: e[k]=v
        self.p=subprocess.Popen(["./executable"]+args, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=e, cwd=cwd)
        inp=("\n".join(files)+ ("\n" if files else "")).encode()
        self.p.stdin.write(inp); self.p.stdin.close(); self.p.stdin=None
        # set nonblocking
        for f in (self.p.stdout, self.p.stderr):
            fl=fcntl.fcntl(f, fcntl.F_GETFL); fcntl.fcntl(f, fcntl.F_SETFL, fl|os.O_NONBLOCK)
        self.out=b""; self.err=b""
    def poll_read(self, seconds=0.5):
        end=time.time()+seconds
        while time.time()<end:
            r,_,_=select.select([self.p.stdout, self.p.stderr], [], [], 0.05)
            for f in r:
                try:
                    data=os.read(f.fileno(), 65536)
                except BlockingIOError:
                    data=b""
                if data:
                    if f is self.p.stdout: self.out+=data
                    else: self.err+=data
            # if process ended, drain
            if self.p.poll() is not None:
                # brief drain
                time.sleep(0.05)
                for f in (self.p.stdout, self.p.stderr):
                    try:
                        while True:
                            data=os.read(f.fileno(), 65536)
                            if not data: break
                            if f is self.p.stdout: self.out+=data
                            else: self.err+=data
                    except: pass
                break
        return self.out, self.err
    def snapshot(self):
        o,e=self.out,self.err
        self.out=b""; self.err=b""
        return o,e
    def read_and_print(self, label, seconds=0.5):
        self.poll_read(seconds)
        o,e=self.snapshot()
        print(f"{label}: rc={self.p.poll()} out={o!r} err={e!r}")
        return o,e
    def kill(self, sig=signal.SIGINT):
        if self.p.poll() is None:
            self.p.send_signal(sig)
            try:
                rc=self.p.wait(timeout=2)
            except:
                self.p.kill(); rc=self.p.wait()
        else:
            rc=self.p.poll()
        self.poll_read(0.2)
        o,e=self.snapshot()
        print(f"exit: rc={rc} out={o!r} err={e!r}")
        return rc

import os, signal, time

from harness import Entr
import os, time
def trial(delay_after_start):
    e=Entr(["-n","/tmp/tt/startend.sh"],["/tmp/ttrig/a"],env={"EV_TRACE":"1"})
    # read initial output as soon as appears by polling repeatedly small
    start=time.time(); init_end=None
    while time.time()-start<2:
        e.poll_read(0.05)
        if e.out.count(b"\n")>=2:
            init_end=float(e.out.decode().splitlines()[1]); break
    e.snapshot()
    # delay relative to init_end timestamp (child's second date)
    # sleep until that + delay
    now=time.time(); target=init_end+delay_after_start
    if target>now: time.sleep(target-now)
    twrite=time.time(); open("/tmp/ttrig/a","a").write("x")
    e.poll_read(1)
    runs=[float(x)-init_end for x in e.out.decode().splitlines()]
    print(f"delay={delay_after_start:.3f} actual write offset={twrite-init_end:.3f} runs={runs} err={e.err}")
    e.kill()
for d in [0,0.01,0.03,0.05,0.07,0.09,0.11]:
    trial(d)

import subprocess, os, time, signal, select, fcntl, re
class Entr:
    def __init__(self, prog, args, files, env=None, cwd="/workspace"):
        e=dict(os.environ)
        if env:
            for k,v in env.items():
                if v is None: e.pop(k,None)
                else: e[k]=v
        self.p=subprocess.Popen([prog]+args, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=e, cwd=cwd)
        inp=("\n".join(files)+("\n" if files else "")).encode()
        self.p.stdin.write(inp); self.p.stdin.close(); self.p.stdin=None
        for f in (self.p.stdout,self.p.stderr):
            fl=fcntl.fcntl(f,fcntl.F_GETFL); fcntl.fcntl(f,fcntl.F_SETFL,fl|os.O_NONBLOCK)
        self.out=b""; self.err=b""; self.log=[]
    def poll_read(self,seconds=0.5):
        end=time.time()+seconds
        while time.time()<end:
            r,_,_=select.select([self.p.stdout,self.p.stderr],[],[],0.05)
            for f in r:
                try: data=os.read(f.fileno(),65536)
                except: data=b""
                if data:
                    if f is self.p.stdout: self.out+=data
                    else: self.err+=data
            if self.p.poll() is not None:
                time.sleep(0.05)
                for f in (self.p.stdout,self.p.stderr):
                    try:
                        while True:
                            data=os.read(f.fileno(),65536)
                            if not data: break
                            if f is self.p.stdout: self.out+=data
                            else: self.err+=data
                    except: pass
                break
        return self.out,self.err
    def snap(self,label,seconds=0.8):
        self.poll_read(seconds)
        o,e=self.out,self.err; self.out=b""; self.err=b""
        # normalize pids in pyserv output
        o=re.sub(rb'pid=\d+',b'pid=N',o); o=re.sub(rb'pgid=\d+',b'pgid=N',o); o=re.sub(rb'ppid=\d+',b'ppid=N',o); o=re.sub(rb'START \d+',b'START N',o)
        item=(label,self.p.poll(),o,e)
        self.log.append(item)
        return item
    def kill(self,sig=signal.SIGINT):
        if self.p.poll() is None:
            self.p.send_signal(sig)
            try: rc=self.p.wait(timeout=3)
            except: self.p.kill(); rc=self.p.wait()
        else: rc=self.p.poll()
        self.poll_read(0.2)
        o,e=self.out,self.err; self.out=b""; self.err=b""
        o=re.sub(rb'pid=\d+',b'pid=N',o); o=re.sub(rb'pgid=\d+',b'pgid=N',o); o=re.sub(rb'ppid=\d+',b'ppid=N',o); o=re.sub(rb'START \d+',b'START N',o)
        self.log.append(("exit",rc,o,e))
        return rc

def compare(name, scenario):
    logs=[]
    for prog in ["/tmp/refbin/executable","/workspace/executable"]:
        e=scenario(prog)
        logs.append(e.log)
    ok=logs[0]==logs[1]
    print(("OK " if ok else "DIFF ")+name)
    if not ok:
        print(" REF:")
        for x in logs[0]: print("  ",x)
        print(" NEW:")
        for x in logs[1]: print("  ",x)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"/tmp")
from wharness import Entr,compare
import os,time,shutil
def make(gaps,flags=["-n"]):
    def sc(prog):
        shutil.rmtree("/tmp/wt",ignore_errors=True); os.makedirs("/tmp/wt"); open("/tmp/wt/a","w").write("x")
        e=Entr(prog,flags+["date","+%s.%N"],["/tmp/wt/a"],env={"EV_TRACE":"1"})
        # snap method poll .8; initial date line will be normalized? It doesn't normalize dates -> logs differ absolute. Use echo instead for count
        e.kill(); return e
    return sc
# Instead count runs with echo and use gaps after trigger
def sc_gap(gap):
    def sc(prog):
        shutil.rmtree("/tmp/wt",ignore_errors=True); os.makedirs("/tmp/wt"); open("/tmp/wt/a","w").write("x"); open("/tmp/wt/b","w").write("x")
        e=Entr(prog,["-n","echo","RUN","/_"],["/tmp/wt/a","/tmp/wt/b"],env={"EV_TRACE":"1"})
        e.snap("init",0.8)
        open("/tmp/wt/a","a").write("x"); time.sleep(gap); open("/tmp/wt/b","a").write("x")
